$comment: Locked study area for the Oct 6 base prototype. READ docs/OCT6_STATUS.md before changing any number here -- every downstream artefact (DTM clip, land-class grid, wet grid, heatmap, camera) is derived from this file.
name: Hung Shui Kiu / Ha Tsuen New Development Area
nameZh: 洪水橋 / 厦村新發展區

provenance.warning: This is NOT the gazetted NDA boundary. It is a rectangular operational extent derived from machine-retrieved public place anchors, chosen so the sandbox has a stable, citable rectangle on Oct 6. It must be replaced by the sheet extent of OZP S/HSK/3 (or an equivalent CSDI dataset) before the 18 Oct submission.
provenance.method: Union of OpenStreetMap place anchors for the NDA's two constituent areas, padded for context and snapped outward to a 4-decimal grid. Coordinates were NOT typed from memory.

anchors.label: Hung Shui Kiu Station works (NDA core, MTR Tuen Ma Line)

grid.note: Working grid for scripts/make_wetgrid.py and scripts/make_heatmap.py. A 5 m grid over this extent is roughly 667 x 740 cells -- numpy handles that in well under a second (ADR-009).

knownGaps: No gazetted NDA polygon was retrievable on Oct 6: the OSM Overpass mirror timed out repeatedly and Nominatim returns points, not the NDA boundary. Overpass is the route to close this -- query relation/way for the HSK/HT NDA landuse and replace the rectangle.
The document's second anchor (San Tin / Tai Sang Wai / Mai Po, Deep Bay) is NOT used. See ADR-002: geography is HSK/HT for the Oct 6 prototype.

Extent area is approximately 780 ha, against a documented ~707 ha 'wider HSK' and ~441 ha development area. The rectangle is intentionally larger than the development area so the baseline includes its rural context.

terrain.note: No real DTM is shipped. The Lands Dept 5 m DTM (Whole_HK_DTM_5m.zip, ~290 MB) was NOT downloaded: it needs explicit permission and it is not bare-earth (it carries elevated roads and depicts vegetation height). The wet grid therefore runs on a synthetic surface, and that limitation is stated in the UI. See docs/OCT6_STATUS.md D1.

imagery.note: No Ion token. OpenStreetMap tiles via UrlTemplateImageryProvider / OpenStreetMapImageryProvider so the demo runs with zero credentials (ADR-033).

landClass.note: Awaiting Lia's independent land-class grid. Until it lands, make_heatmap.py classifies from a coarse synthetic/OSM-derived surrogate and labels itself as such.

attribution: Contains information from OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
Outline Zoning Plan S/HSK/3 (Town Planning Board) is the authoritative land-use source for this area and has not yet been ingested as geometry.
